Heramba-Gaṇapati
------------------------------------------
Gaṇapati or गणेश, the elephant-faced god, is an extremely popular deity of the Hindu pantheon. Out of the several aspects of this god, the हेरम्ब-गणपति is also one, which seems to be more popular in Nepal. ‘Heramba’ means one puffed up with the pride of strength and valour.
गणपति.jpg" src="http://eoh.rkmathbangalore.org/public/images/thumbs/Heramba-Ga%E1%B9%87apati.jpg" alt="Heramba-गणपति">This गणपति has five faces and ten arms in which he holds broken tusk, club, rosary, goad, a fruit, axe, sweet (modaka) and a noose. The other two hands exhibit the abhaya and the varada mudrās (offering protection and boons).
See also GAṆAPATI.
